sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The approved supplier list has an approval for BR-180 only for SUP-C (PLT-BEI, CUST-AUR). It has no approval for SUP-B on BR-180. SUP-B's approvals cover BR-220 and BR-225 only. Company approval does not extend to other parts, so SUP-B is not released for BR-180.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

An approval for one part does not
extend to another part, even if made of the same material.

findings.why: BR-180 is on PRG-Z, an Aurelia program. Adding a new source is a change of source. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. It requires written Aurelia approval (PPAP) before shipment and 90 days' notice. Approval is per part and site. No existing approval or deviation covers SUP-B for BR-180.
